text: Yes, tree-cover loss was detected on the property after 2020. In 2025, a loss event of 13.5 hectares (3.9% of the asset) was observed, primarily in areas confirmed as forest in 2020 by the JRC dataset (98% overlap). No loss was recorded between 2020 and 2024. The detection meets the analysis thresholds: events ≥0.5 ha, tree cover ≥30%, and corroboration by the 2020 JRC baseline.
